a rare [👀 teaser](/?date=2026-10-05&category=social#item-f49c0beda6a0) (338 likes / 29k views) stoked anticipation of an upcoming announcement, and he confirmed the team simply ['pushes updates that fast.'](/?date=2026-10-05&category=social#item-54676f2dc8c6) Practical and technical threads: [desktop access via installing the CLI and running **hermes desktop**](/?date=2026-10-05&category=social#item-f5026b164d52), [**AGENTS.md** loading capped at **32k tokens**](/?date=2026-10-05&category=social#item-6a613800e0c3), **Teknium** publicly venting ['how are we only **64k context** on this still'](/?date=2026-10-05&category=social#item-b785e462e348) (a possible roadmap signal), and his argument that [smarter models don't remove integration friction — **MCP**s and connectors remain necessary plumbing](/?date=2026-10-05&category=social#item-5ebadcbd036b). **Community & Culture** — The warmest moments: **@NousResearch** told **@kunchenguid** ['Hermes is yours'](/?date=2026-10-05&category=social#item-0ca9b5a0bb1b) (487 likes), **Teknium** [redirected credit for showcased builds to **@witcheer**](/?date=2026-10-05&category=social#item-c4f317fea64a) (including a [Star Trek-themed setup made for a community member](/?date=2026-10-05&category=social#item-8efce851e876)), the viral ['We got **ESP32** at home' quip](/?date=2026-10-05&category=social#item-f10787cbfb5c) (1,185 likes / 77k views) fueled in-house-hardware speculation, and [Hermes earned mainstream visibility via **@linusgsebastian**'s WAN show](/?date=2026-10-05&category=social#item-176ec304b321);
